name: harness-team
description: Run every work task as a five-role harness team: a lead who never asks what the goal is and fixes the last task's mistakes first, an obsessive perfectionist final reviewer, and a carry-over ledger.

interface.shortDescription: Five-role team with a perfectionist final review and carry-over fixes
interface.longDescription: A lead infers the goal without asking and first fixes the previous task's mistakes; a scout, builder and verifier do the work; an obsessive perfectionist reviews it once and every finding is applied right away; findings that cannot be applied and the lead's own mistakes carry over.
defaultPrompt: Run this task as the harness team.
